name: Remove /awos:hire: delete the agent template, tombstone the command body (a preserved .claude/commands/awos/hire.md wrapper resolves to a removal notice), and remove the awos-recruitment MCP entry

content: `/awos:hire` was removed in AWOS 2.0. AWOS no longer provisions agents: they come from the host's own ecosystem (project `.claude/agents/` files and plugins).
Tell the user the following, then stop. Do not create or install any agent files.

- This command no longer exists. Staffing is handled on the path: `/awos:tasks` surfaces a staffing gap as an open question when no installed agent covers a task, and `/awos:implement` falls back to `general-purpose` and reports the substitution.
- Agents previously installed under `.claude/agents/` are theirs to keep or delete.
- This notice comes from a leftover command wrapper. To remove it, delete `.claude/commands/awos/hire.md` and `.awos/commands/hire.md`.
